description: Free, no API key. Checks whether an exact sentence appears on a public HTTPS page: verbatim (quotes cut with '...' allowed if the pieces are in order and close), stitched (pieces far apart or reordered), paraphrase (most 4-word runs present), not_found or unreachable. not_found means these words are not on the page; it does NOT mean the claim is false (a faithful rewording also reads not_found). Use it before acting on another agent's quote: one link + the exact sentence. Read-only single GET, no login, no JavaScript, SSRF-checked; who wrote the page is still yours to judge.
name: verify_quote
title: Verify Quote
